passages.text: Our class welcomes two visitors who are from a school in another town. They will spend the morning working with us on a simple design task. We get on well with them because we take turns explaining our ideas and asking about theirs. One visitor suggests folding the paper base, while my partner suggests adding a wide support. Instead of choosing immediately, we test both ideas and compare how steadily the model stands. The final design uses parts of both suggestions, and everyone can explain why we chose them.

parallelText.en: Our class welcomes two visitors who are from a school in another town.
parallelText.zh: 我们班欢迎两位来自另一座城镇学校的访客。

parallelText.en: They will spend the morning working with us on a simple design task.
parallelText.zh: 他们将用一个上午和我们一起完成简单设计任务。

parallelText.en: We get on well with them because we take turns explaining our ideas and asking about theirs.
parallelText.zh: 我们轮流解释自己的想法并询问他们的想法，因此相处融洽。

parallelText.en: One visitor suggests folding the paper base, while my partner suggests adding a wide support.
parallelText.zh: 一位访客建议折纸底座，我的搭档建议加宽支撑。

parallelText.en: Instead of choosing immediately, we test both ideas and compare how steadily the model stands.
parallelText.zh: 我们不立即选择，而是测试两种想法，比较模型站得多稳。

parallelText.en: The final design uses parts of both suggestions, and everyone can explain why we chose them.
parallelText.zh: 最后设计结合了两种建议，大家都能解释选择理由。

wordHelp.meaning: something that holds another thing up

passages.text: The drama group tries to open a stuck costume box again and again. Nobody pulls hard, because the costumes inside belong to another class. A helper notices a small label that says the box has a catch under the handle. She calls the teacher at once instead of forcing the lid. The teacher releases the catch, and at last the group can take out the costumes safely. They put a clearer note on the box so the next group will know how to open it.

parallelText.en: The drama group tries to open a stuck costume box again and again.
parallelText.zh: 戏剧小组一遍遍尝试打开卡住的戏服箱。

parallelText.en: Nobody pulls hard, because the costumes inside belong to another class.
parallelText.zh: 没人使劲拉，因为箱里的服装属于别的班。

parallelText.en: A helper notices a small label that says the box has a catch under the handle.
parallelText.zh: 一位帮忙者注意到标签写着把手下面有一个扣。

parallelText.en: She calls the teacher at once instead of forcing the lid.
parallelText.zh: 她立即叫老师，没有强行拉箱盖。

parallelText.en: The teacher releases the catch, and at last the group can take out the costumes safely.
parallelText.zh: 老师松开扣子，小组终于能安全取出服装。

parallelText.en: They put a clearer note on the box so the next group will know how to open it.
parallelText.zh: 他们在箱上贴了一张更清楚的说明，让下一组知道怎么打开。
